packages.name: bip-kit
packages.description: Building in Public, as a content contract: parse markdown into typed blocks and render them with a reference React renderer (bip-kit/react) — blog, roadmap, changelog on your product site, bring your own design tokens.

packages.name: @bitbaum/mail-kit
packages.description: The fleet's one email layer: Resend over raw fetch, zero dependencies, honest never-throwing results, sandbox/placeholder guards, and the shared-sender convention encoded once.

packages.name: limitkit
packages.description: Rate limiting as a decision, not a middleware: fixed and sliding windows over an injectable store, a bounded in-memory store, standard RateLimit headers, and client-IP extraction. No HTTP client, no framework.

packages.name: ai-forms
packages.description: Headless AI form filling and conversational refinement. Provider-agnostic core, React hook, and a server route factory.

packages.name: @bitbaum/design-tokens
packages.description: Design SSOT for OrangeCat, Loki and Solon — tokens, self-hosted faces, and the Tailwind preset that maps them.

packages.name: listkit
packages.description: A list as a query: a closed set of facet kinds, a URL codec that copies rather than rebuilds, a comparator that puts missing values last, and page arithmetic that cannot produce a negative offset. No markup, no React, no HTTP client.

packages.name: @bitbaum/chatkit
packages.description: One chat for every product: a composer with a microphone that always works, a thread that does not fight the reader, messages with copy and retry, and LLM markdown — the fleet's chat standard as a package.

packages.name: threadkit
packages.description: Headless multi-participant message threads. Permission is participation, unread is per-person, and an AI can be a participant subject to the same visibility rules as everyone else.

packages.name: @bitbaum/accountkit
packages.description: One account for every bitbaum product: the account menu, and Sign in with OrangeCat (provider, session refresh, identity rules, error screen). Styled from @bitbaum/design-tokens.

packages.name: @bitbaum/sitekit
packages.description: A website as data: a closed union of section shapes validated at runtime, one set of React renderers, and per-field provenance so a generated site can prove it fabricated nothing.

packages.name: @bitbaum/speechkit
packages.description: Measure how somebody spoke — pauses, rate, where they searched for a word, grammar a listener would notice — and say only what the evidence allows. Language-agnostic; no pronunciation score, on purpose.

packages.name: @bitbaum/paykit
packages.description: Let a website get paid without holding the money. Classify a pasted Bitcoin receive string, and record a shown code (Twint, another currency) the visitor pays in their own app.
